svg.aria-label: Areas: Systems: Rust execution engines, shared-memory IPC, zero-copy data paths, kernel-bypass I/O; Quant research: Regime detection (HMM, HSMM, Kalman), walk-forward validation, CPCV, Monte Carlo; Strategy engineering: Turning visual (price-action) strategies into precise, testable trading algorithms, filters and adaptive indicators; Trading platforms: MT5 (MQL5), cTrader (cAlgo C#), NinjaTrader, TradingView (Pine Script v6), NautilusTrader; Custom platforms: Research and execution platforms, FIX protocol connectivity, CLI tools and GUI applications; Full-stack web: Complete websites and web applications: frontend, backend APIs, databases, with security and encryption; Desktop: Tauri desktop applications, PySide6 trading workstations
